action_items.detail: Clicking hud-menu-button then the 'switch journey' dropdown item intercepted subsequent pointer events via a lingering base-ui portal overlay in automated runs, causing click timeouts. Worked around by switching journey via localStorage state + reload (same effect, no UI dependency) in no-horizontal-scroll-core-screens and regression-core-gameplay-after-layout-fix. This may also affect real users double-clicking the menu quickly; worth a quick manual check of the HUD dropdown's overlay dismissal, though it did not block any acceptance criterion.

checks.criterion: No horizontal scrolling on title/cinematic/journey-select/journey-hub/father-arena/question-attack overlay/battle-result/shivam-monster-battle screens across 320x640 up to 2560x1440
checks.name: no-horizontal-scroll-core-screens
checks.evidence: Walked title -> cinematic -> journey select -> father hub -> father arena -> battle overlay -> battle result -> shivam monster battle, checking document.scrollWidth<=clientWidth (tolerance 2px) at 320x640, 390x844, 640x360, 768x1024, 1280x720, 1366x768, 1920x1080, 2560x1440 for each screen. No overflow detected anywhere.

checks.criterion: Shivam monster battle stage (monster-stage) at short/zoomed viewports keeps HP bar and monster silhouette fully inside the stage
checks.name: monster-stage-elements-not-clipped
checks.evidence: At 1280x720, 1366x768 and 640x360, monster-hp bounding box and the monster SVG bounding box stayed within monster-stage bounding box (y within [stage.y, stage.y+stage.height] +-2px tolerance). Screenshot at 1280x720 shows HP bar and monster fully visible, not clipped.

checks.criterion: Opening cinematic keeps visible height at short viewports; dialogue/Next/Skip reachable
checks.name: cinematic-stage-min-height-short-viewport
checks.evidence: cinematic-stage boundingBox height was >=200px at both 640x360 and 1280x600; cinematic-next-button and cinematic-skip-button were scrollable into view and clickable, advancing the beat / landing on journey select respectively.

checks.criterion: Top HUD bar buttons fit within viewport and are clickable at 320/360/390/768/1024/1440 widths; wordmark doesn't overlap
checks.name: hud-fits-small-viewports
checks.evidence: At each width, hud-resume-vault-button, hud-learning-journal-button, hud-audio-toggle, hud-menu-button were visible, within [0,width] horizontally and within the game-hud vertical bounds, and the wordmark's right edge stayed left of the vault button's left edge. No doc overflow at any width. Screenshot at 320px confirms compact icon-only layout without clipping.

checks.criterion: Father question-attack overlay sprites fully inside stage at 640x360/390x844; dialogue + skip/continue reachable
checks.name: father-overlay-fits-short-viewports
checks.evidence: battle-papa-sprite and battle-shivam-sprite bounding boxes stayed inside battle-stage bounds at both sizes; battle-skip-button and battle-continue-button were reachable via scroll and clicked successfully, advancing through to battle-result at each viewport with no doc overflow.

checks.criterion: Finale stage sprites inside stage + spotlight popup scrollable/closable at 390x844 and 640x360
checks.name: finale-and-spotlight-fit-short-viewports
checks.evidence: finale-stage sprites' bounding boxes stayed within stage bounds at both sizes (screenshot shows Papa/Miss Growth/Shivam sprites visible, no scroll). spotlight-dialog opened and spotlight-close-button was reachable and clickable at both 390x844 and 640x360.

checks.criterion: Regression: Shivam growth arena win -> spotlight debrief; Father G1 attack -> skip -> continue; state persisted under dilwale-job-le-jayenge:v1; no console errors

checks.evidence: move-play-grow_measure won immediately, arena-open-spotlight-button opened spotlight-dialog (Victory Debrief); G1 attack -> battle-skip-button -> battle-result -> battle-continue-button set attack-card-G1 data-outcome=proven; localStorage key dilwale-job-le-jayenge:v1 contained progress.father.resolvedKeys=['G1'] and progress.shivam.spotlightsViewed containing 'growth'; zero non-benign console errors captured.
